notes: Expedition relics (docs/arena-v2.md section 4). A relic is owned for the rest of the run. What each id DOES is code (services/expedition_service.py + services/arena_service.py); this file holds the names, texts, shop prices and how often each is offered. A new id needs code too (game_content.KNOWN_RELICS).
weight: relative chance to be offered (treasure, relic choice, shop stock). price: run gold in the shop.

relics.name: Aegis
relics.description: The first wrong answer of each battle costs no hearts.

relics.name: Phoenix Ash
relics.description: Once per run, revive with 3 hearts instead of falling.

relics.name: Scholar's Lens
relics.description: Weakness hits deal triple damage instead of double.

relics.name: Quill
relics.description: A correct Jab grants +2 extra Focus (instead of +1).

relics.name: Hourglass
relics.description: The first Timewarp of each battle is free.

relics.name: Vampiric Tome
relics.description: Heal 1 heart every time your combo reaches 5.
